blocked.why: Not reached. Researched: a mana ability's choices are made as it's activated — offered as variants (`manaColors`, `manaFor`) — but which artifact cards to reveal is a hidden-information pick a variant per subset can't carry. The precedent to follow: a mana ability whose cost sacrifices several pauses on the `sacrifice` decision (`pendingCostSacrifice`) and resolves in `finishCostSacrifice`; a reveal would pause on a choose-from-zone of the hand's artifact cards (any number) the same way, then add {C}{C} each. The auto-payer leaves it out (its output is a choice).
